data.name: Mirzaan
data.gender_notes: Mirzaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mirzaan is a name that symbolizes royalty and nobility, derived from the Persian word 'mirza', meaning prince or noble. It is often associated with the heavens and the sky. The name Mirzaan carries the meaning “Prince of the Sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mirzaan usually hope their child will grow to embody prince of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mirzaan is believed to be a name that reflects the nobility and generosity of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.etymology: Mirzaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prince of the Sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirzaan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
